model.activity

Class CleaningActivity

  • java.lang.Object
    • model.activity.Activity
      • model.activity.CleaningActivity

  • public class CleaningActivity
extends Activity
    Represents a cleaning activity for a specific habitat. This class extends the `Activity` class and includes additional attributes specific to cleaning activities, such as the cleaning method used.

        id - The unique identifier of the activity. Must not be null or empty.
        habitat - The habitat associated with the activity. Must not be null.
        responsible - The employee responsible for the activity. Must not be null.
        schedulingDate - The date the activity is scheduled for. Must not be null.
        description - The description of the cleaning activity. Must not be null or empty.
        usedProducts - A list of products used for the cleaning activity. Must not be null.
